verdict.rationale: RingCentral documents a Business SMS Booster with a shared inbox for customer texts, Call Queues for routing calls to a team, and separate team messaging, so several teammates can work one number. The evidence does not document presence on the shared line, assigning conversations, or internal comment threads on customer conversations. Missing for 10: presence indicators, conversation assignment, internal threads on shared conversations, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, several teammates share one number with presence, conversation assignment, and internal threads

citations.quote: Business SMS Booster Manage customer texts with a shared inbox, templates, and compliance tools.
Call Queues Booster Shorten wait times with better routing, insights, and callbacks.
The entire suite of RingEX features, including voice, auto attendant, online meetings, team messaging, fax and conferencing are available during the trial.
